Greedy Meshing Project Description This project implements a 2D and 3D greedy meshing algorithm in Python. Greedy meshing is a technique used to optimize the rendering of voxel-based graphics by merging adjacent voxels (or 'blocks') into larger cuboids, thereby reducing the complexity of the mesh.
